doodle-jump-ninja.title: Doodle Jump Ninja - Free Online Ninja Adventure Game
doodle-jump-ninja.slogan: Leap, climb, and conquer in Doodle Jump Ninja!
doodle-jump-ninja.description: Doodle Jump Ninja takes you on an exhilarating journey where you leap through the air as a skilled ninja. With its unique map and engaging gameplay, you'll experience super jumps and challenging obstacles. The game's doodle graphics are beautifully crafted, making each move a visual delight. Prove your skills by climbing the leaderboard and collecting scores. Dive into this addictive adventure and see how far you can go!
